title: Noctilucent Condenser
pages: Craft this second t6 apparatus from two sealed steel plates (top corners), two Hex Bolt Sets (bottom corners) hot-headed from Steel Billet in the Coal Forge, a Solar Prism from the Heliostat Etcher, one phantom membrane (left of centre), a Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchanger (right of centre), the reserved Iridescent Key from the Iridescent Basin, and a resonance infuser. Both the prism and the key are required: the two t6 apparatus lines converge here. The bolts clamp the condenser shell to its base flange; plain plates cannot stand in for them. Heat exchanger route: craft an Unexpanded Tube Bundle from seven Drawn Copper Tubes (Wire Drawing Bench, two copper ingots each) with two Sealed Steel Plates as tubesheets in the top and bottom middle slots; roller-expand it on the Flange Press; then shell it with two Stainless Vessel Stock (top and bottom middle), two Brazed Joints as inlet/outlet nozzles (left and right) and two Hex Bolt Sets and two Tab Lock Washers in opposite head-flange corners; stamp one Tool Steel Stock in the Pressure Press to get four washers. The copper tubes carry the cold side and chill the night vapour on the shell side so it condenses; an unexpanded bundle, loose tubes or a membrane cannot fill that slot. Flow rates, U-value and tube-side fluid are not simulated. The upper stainless stock is now a Mineral Fibre Lagging mat from two magma blocks in the powered Clinker Oven; it thermally isolates the shell from the upper head. The lower stainless stock remains. Plain stock cannot replace the mat.

Keep the block directly below open sky and operate during night. Work pauses without spending FE whenever the sky is lit or covered. Lunar Essence, condensed from phantom membranes, is this apparatus’ own progression material.

Twenty datapack condensing recipes make useful soul lighting, navigation, redstone, dye and decorative items from nether, end and deep-dark reagents. Two fermented spider eyes can be recovered as two plain eyes at night, matching the Provision Hearth's one-for-one fermentation rate. JEI shows counts, results, FE and the night-sky condition. Recipe type: arcana_industry:condensing; fields ingredient, count, result, duration, energy_per_tick and optional priority.

Top and horizontal faces import; bottom exports. Each side is configurable in the GUI. Supply 16 FE/t or use the manual crank. Inventory, FE, progress and port modes persist; breaking drops inventory.
